                    stop: function (event, ui) {

                        });

                    }
                });
                $(window).resize(function () {
                    $('#PageMessage').draggable({
                        containment: "window"
                    });

                });

            catch (err) {
                console.error('error: ' + err);
            }
        });

        //FUNCTION TO GET AND AUTO PLAY YOUTUBE VIDEO FROM DATATAG
        function autoPlayYouTubeModal() {
            var trigger = $("body").find('[data-toggle="modal"]');
            trigger.click(function () {
                var theModal = $(this).data("target"),
                    videoSRC = $(this).attr("data-theVideo"),
                    videoTitle = $(this).attr("data-videoTitle"),
                    videoSRCauto = videoSRC + "?autoplay=1&rel=0";
                $(theModal + ' iframe').attr('src', videoSRCauto);
                $(theModal + ' .modal-title').html(videoTitle);
                $('#videoModal').on('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
                    $('#videoModal iframe').removeAttr('src');
                })
            });

            $("#autoclick").click();
        }



        $(document).ready(function () {
            autoPlayYouTubeModal();
        });

        function CallUDF() {
            var c = document.getElementById("searchrowbox").value;
            c = jQuery.trim(c);
            var val = 0;
            if (c.indexOf('/') == 0) {
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/https-web-service/commonwebservice.asmx/SearchLinkExists",
                    type: "POST",
                    dataType: "json",
                    data: JSON.stringify({ link: c }),
                    processData: false,
                    contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8;",
                    success: function (data) {
                        if (data.d == 1) {
                            val = 1;
                            window.open(c, '_blank');
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
                if ((c != 'search efile.com...') && (c != 'buscar...') && (c != '') && (val != 1)) {
                    window.location.href = "/tax-service/efile-tax-search/free-online-tax-help-advice?str=" + c;
                }
                else {
                    $("#searchrowbox").tooltip('show');
                }
            },
                500);

        }

        /* Countdown Script */
        var deadline = new Date("October 16, 2019 00:00:00").getTime();

        var x = setInterval(function () {

            var now = new Date().getTime();
            var t = deadline - now;
            //console.log(t);
            var days = Math.floor(t / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            var hours = Math.floor((t % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
            var minutes = Math.floor((t % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
            var seconds = Math.floor((t % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
            document.getElementById("day").innerHTML = days;
            document.getElementById("hour").innerHTML = hours;
            document.getElementById("minute").innerHTML = minutes;
            document.getElementById("second").innerHTML = seconds;
            if (t < 0) {
                clearInterval(x);
                //document.getElementById("clockdiv").innerHTML = "<span style='font-size:16px; color:black; font-weight:400; display: block; padding-top: 10px;'>Tax Return Deadline has Passed.<br><a href='https://mytaxes.efile.com/1040/signup' target='_blank' style='font-size:16px;'>Start and efile Now!</a></span>";
                document.getElementById("clockdiv").innerHTML = "";

                $('#clockdiv').css('display', 'block');
                /*document.getElementById("day").innerHTML = '0';
                document.getElementById("hour").innerHTML = '0';
                document.getElementById("minute").innerHTML = '0';
                document.getElementById("second").innerHTML = '0';*/
            } else if (t < 86400000) {
                clearInterval(x);
                //document.getElementById("clockdiv").innerHTML = "<span style='font-size:16px; color:black; font-weight:400; display: block; padding-top: 10px;'>Tax Return Deadline is Today, April 15, 2019 at Midnight.<br><a href='https://mytaxes.efile.com/1040/signup' target='_blank' style='font-size:16px;'>Start and efile Now!</a></span>";
                document.getElementById("clockdiv").innerHTML = "<span style='font-size:16px; color:black; font-weight:400; display: block; padding-top: 10px;'>Tax Return Deadline is Today, <a href='/oct-deadline/' id='countdownclicklink'>October 15, 2019</a> at Midnight.<br><a href='https://mytaxes.efile.com/1040/signup' target='_blank' style='font-size:16px;'>Start and efile Now!</a></span>";
                $('#clockdiv').css('display', 'block');
                /*document.getElementById("day").innerHTML = '0';
                document.getElementById("hour").innerHTML = '0';
                document.getElementById("minute").innerHTML = '0';
                document.getElementById("second").innerHTML = '0';*/
            } else {

                $('#clockdiv').css('display', 'block');
            }
        }, 1000);

    </script>
